meta.title: Kora OS | About Kora
meta.description: Learn how Kora connects the people, customers, products, services, payments and everyday operations behind modern businesses.

about.headline: Built to make running a business simpler.
about.intro: Kora is a business platform designed to bring the everyday parts of running a business together in one connected place.
about.storyTitle: A clearer way to run the everyday.
about.operations: From staff and customers to appointments, walk-ins, services, products, payments and performance, Kora helps business owners and their teams stay organised, work efficiently and understand what is happening across their business.
about.fragmentation: Many businesses still depend on a mix of notebooks, spreadsheets, messaging apps, separate payment records and disconnected tools. Kora brings these activities together, giving businesses a clearer way to manage their operations and make better decisions.
about.serviceBusinesses: For businesses that serve customers through appointments and walk-ins, Kora provides tools for bookings, queues, staff schedules, service delivery and customer management.
about.productBusinesses: For businesses that sell products, Kora is being built to bring products, transactions, customers and business performance into the same connected experience.
about.marketplace: Kora also creates a bridge between businesses and their customers. Through the Kora Marketplace, customers can discover businesses, explore what they offer and interact with them through a simpler digital experience.
about.scale: Whether a business operates from one location or manages a growing network of branches, Kora is being built to provide greater visibility and control.

connected.title: The essentials, working together.
connected.body: See the moving parts of your business in one clear operating picture.

about.attribution: Kora is developed by Realtegic Tech Solutions.

meta.title: Kora OS | Our Mission
meta.description: Kora’s mission is to make everyday business operations easier to run, grow and understand through one connected platform.

mission.headline: Make business easier to run, easier to grow and easier to understand.
mission.intro: Our mission is to give businesses a simpler way to manage the people, customers, products, services, payments and everyday activities that keep them moving.
mission.belief: We believe business owners should not need multiple disconnected systems to understand what is happening in their business.
mission.narrative: Kora brings essential operations together so owners and teams can spend less time managing fragmented processes and more time serving customers and growing their businesses.

simplify.title: SIMPLIFY OPERATIONS
simplify.body: Bring everyday business activities into one connected platform.

visibility.title: CREATE VISIBILITY
visibility.body: Help owners understand what is happening across their teams, customers, locations and performance.

connections.title: STRENGTHEN CUSTOMER CONNECTIONS
connections.body: Make it easier for customers to discover, book, buy from and engage with businesses.

growth.title: SUPPORT GROWTH
growth.body: Give businesses a platform that can grow with them from a single location to multiple branches and larger operations.

vision.title: Where we’re going.
vision.body: Our long-term vision is for Kora to become the platform businesses rely on every day to run their operations and connect with their customers.
